chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The ground of the Day of Resurrection is fire, except for the shade of the believer, for indeed his charity gives him shade."

key_terms.الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, when people are raised and judged
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer, the one characterized by faith
key_terms.تُظِلُّهُ: it shades him, meaning it provides shelter for him
key_terms.صَدَقَتَهُ: his charity, the almsgiving that becomes a means of protection
key_terms.ظِلَّ: shade or shelter that brings protection
key_terms.نَارٌ: fire, describing the harshness of the Resurrection ground

ai.seo_question: How does charity benefit the believer on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the Day of Resurrection is a scene of severe hardship, and that the believer will find protection through his charity. It highlights the lasting spiritual benefit of sadaqah and its role in securing divine mercy in the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1728 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"The ground of the Day of Resurrection will be fire, except for the shade provided for the believer, for his charity will shield him."
